newsitem.title: DENMARK: Three new Danish firms head for top-20 share index.
newsitem.headline: Three new Danish firms head for top-20 share index.

text.p: Three new companies are heading for listing at end-1996 in Copenhagen Stock Exchange's top-20 KFX share index ousting established shares including the SAS airline, according to a bourse report received by Reuters on Monday.
The report says the new listings will be third biggest BG Bank, medical group Christian Hansen Holding and holding company Sophus Berendsen's A-share.

Insurance group Topdanmark, Scandinavian Airlines System (SAS Denmark) and wholesale and shipping group East Asiatic will drop out of the current index to make way for the three newcomers, the report showed.
BG Bank's entry into the KFX index was expected by the market, Chr. Hansen Holding has been a KFX paper previously, while Berendsen's B-share is already listed.
Copenhagen Stock Exchange officially selects new candidates for the top-20 KFX index on November 1, with the new index taking effect on December 23.
